meta.title: Lineup Lab Official Verified Source Registry
meta.policy: Every URL in this registry was retrieved and inspected directly on 2026-11-12 (UTC). Every table row in lineup-lab HTML links to at least one recognized primary-publisher URL (nfl.com, operations.nfl.com, draftkings.com, itl.nist.gov, scikit-learn.org, weather.gov, massgaming.com, gaming.nv.gov, ncpgambling.org, or github.com/karagemop466-tech/Korea2) plus official club depth-chart URLs where applicable. Unconfirmable values are never inferred and remain blank ('').
